arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import json
# 8MiB whitespace-padded valid request
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
base = open('/tmp/max96.json').read()
pad = base[:-1] + ' ' * (8*1024*1024 - len(base) - 1) + '}'
assert len(pad.encode()) == 8*1024*1024, len(pad)
open('/tmp/bigpad.json','w').write(pad)
open('/tmp/bigws.json','w').write(' ' * (8*1024*1024))
# deep nesting
open('/tmp/deep.json','w').write('[' * 200000 + ']' * 200000)
print('built')
" && for f in /tmp/bigpad.json /tmp/bigws.json /tmp/deep.json; do /tmp/timeit.sh $f /tmp/bigout.json; done
